main_body: wooden gong frame with hanging metal gong
top_band: light warm brown horizontal beam top at rows 3-5 (3 rows), plus top faces on the two base blocks at rows 26-28 (3 rows)
evidence: The horizontal top crossbeam shows a clear 3-row light brown top surface (rows 3-5) above a 2-row dark brown front face/underside (rows 6-7), and the two base blocks also show 3-row top surfaces (rows 26-28) above 3-row dark front faces (rows 29-31). The vertical posts and hanging gong sit recessed underneath the overhanging top beam.

style.evidence: The wood uses 5-6 warm brown tones and the brass gong uses 6 gold/ochre tones with concentric metallic sheen and boss highlight. Outlines use dark brown and dark bronze material tones, matching the Beodeul reference props in richness and value separation.
